column1: # Remote URL normalization cases for store-resolver.py --selftest.
# Columns: case name, remote URL as git stores it, expected identity (host/path) or LOCAL.
# Expected values are written by hand from the rules in the Phase 2 contract of
# {CRED}, {CRED2} and {CRED3} (a password holding "/") stand for a user:password@ prefix, {QTOKEN} for a token query, filled in by the selftest so no credential-shaped text sits in the repo.
# Lines starting with # are comments. An empty URL column is written as the word EMPTY.
